name: backend-roadmap
description: Backend Roadmap — curriculum content, the React app (webapp/) and its API (api/, on Cloudflare Pages Functions)

scripts.build: npm --prefix webapp run build && npm run index && node scripts/build/copy-content.mjs && node scripts/build/prerender.mjs
scripts.index: node scripts/build/gen-docs-index.mjs && node scripts/build/gen-search-index.mjs && node scripts/build/gen-site-stats.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p api && tsc -p scripts && tsc -p webapp
scripts.check: node scripts/check/check-admin-guards.mjs && node scripts/check/check-paths.mjs && node scripts/check/check-images.mjs
scripts.preview: npm --prefix webapp exec -- vite preview webapp --outDir ../dist --port 4180 --strictPort
